A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Skyra study. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices are readable and can be matched despite pagination and numbering changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original detection experiments on ViF-Bench and GenVideo, degradation robustness tests, component ablations, and qualitative analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experiments and adds generalization ablation results and a reported analysis of detected artifact frequencies.

M1.justification: The Qwen2.5-VL-7B model, supervised cold start, GRPO training, grounded response templates, and accuracy/check rewards remain unchanged. Equations 1–4 specify the same objectives and reward definitions.

E1.justification: Training and evaluation retain ViF-CoT-4K, ViF-Bench, GenVideo, and the same source datasets and video generators. The new generalization table analyzes coverage already present in v1 rather than introducing another dataset or test population.

E2.justification: New Table 6 adds w/o CoT and w/o SFT controls to the GenVideo comparison; v1 reported component ablations only on ViF-Bench. External baseline membership in Tables 1–3 remains unchanged. Newly cited UniGenDet and DeepTraceReward are not evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Appendix B introduces a component-evaluation design organized into in-generator, cross-generator, and cross-dataset settings. Existing benchmark metrics, training budgets, and preprocessing remain unchanged. Newly stated clip specifications in Table 5 are additional documentation, not evidence of revised settings.

E4.justification: New Appendices B and C extend component ablations to generalization analysis and examine the distribution of detected artifact categories. These supplement the retained reward ablations, degradation tests, baseline failure analyses, and qualitative cases.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seeds, repeated-run variability, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The added tables do not introduce uncertainty estimation or change reporting practices.

E6.justification: Tables 1–4 are unchanged. New Table 6 adds generator-stratified ablation scores and GenVideo accuracies of 51.89% for w/o CoT and 68.34% for w/o SFT; its full-model GenVideo results were already reported in v1. Table 7 presents artifact frequencies as model-output statistics, although its named-category percentages match the earlier training-annotation statistics.

T1.justification: The mathematical loss and reward definitions and artifact taxonomy are unchanged. No formal assumptions, theorems, proofs, or substantive derivations are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: grounded artifact reasoning, ViF-CoT-4K, two-stage training, ViF-Bench, and superior detection performance. The appendix additions do not redefine these core claims.

C2.justification: Appendix B newly interprets SFT as introducing cross-dataset overfitting and RL as recovering generalization. Appendix C interprets artifact frequencies as evidence of semantic reasoning and limited reliance on superficial generator cues. Existing limitations and deployment qualifications remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix A.4 newly specifies 25 professional annotators and manual exclusion of static, ambiguous, or severely distorted samples. Table 5 documents five-second, 81-frame clips and consolidates previously reported training settings and hardware. These are disclosures rather than established changes to implementation.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the bibliography add UniGenDet and concurrent DeepTraceReward, briefly discussing unified generation/detection and explanation-quality evaluation. The existing research positioning is otherwise retained.

P1.justification: v2 expands and renumbers the appendix outline, repairs unresolved outline references, adds acknowledgements, and moves the corresponding-author marker from Lei Chen to Jiwen Lu. Most existing prose and the main section structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 adds Tables 5–7 and renumbers the previous appendix tables as Tables 8–10. Figure 6 moves between columns, and surrounding content reflows. Existing numerical table content and figure imagery are preserved.

improvement.justification: v2 provides useful annotation and filtering details, but the added analyses introduce unresolved reporting ambiguities. New Table 6 gives w/o SFT accuracies of 70.91% and 75.87% on in/cross-generator evaluation, whereas retained Table 4 reports 50.09% for the apparently corresponding w/o Cold-Start variant, without explaining a protocol distinction. New Table 7 also attributes existing training-annotation percentages to ViF-Bench model outputs without clarifying their relationship. These issues prevent a reliable net-quality judgment.
